name: Gates Of Hell
overview: The phrase 'gates of hell' in Scripture symbolizes the powerful threshold of death and the grave, representing a place of ultimate separation from life and God, as seen in references to the 'gates of death' and 'gates of the grave' in Job, Psalms, and Isaiah. Yet, in Matthew 16:18, Jesus declares that the gates of hell will not overcome His church, affirming the victory of Christ’s kingdom over death and eternal punishment. This assures believers that through Christ, the power of death and hell is defeated, offering eternal life rather than everlasting punishment.
